Relative references

  • target.html - same directory
  • ./target.html
  • deep/target.html - one down
  • deep/../target.html - down and back
  • ../simple.html - one up
  • /simple.html - root relative
  • ?query=only - query only
  • #fragment - fragment only
  • target.html?a=1&b=2#part
  • absolute http
  • absolute https
  • unsupported scheme
  • empty href
